O1.citation: “Re-run all golden cases—A, B, and C” and “B alone is insufficient.”

O2.citation: “one fresh, context-free agent per case,” “each runner saw only its case input,” and “Independent judgments: each artifact was graded against that case’s bar.”

O3.citation: Evidence is missing: the artifact calls for only “one fresh, context-free agent per case” and does not require repeated trials or per-case pass rates.

O4.citation: Evidence is missing: the artifact does not require diagnosing a new miss as a skill defect versus a bad case, revising accordingly, and repeating the full sweep.

O5.citation: The artifact requires “Results showing B now passes the previously cited gap,” results showing A and C still pass, and “before/after evidence” tying B’s improvement to the edit.

S1.citation: The smell is absent: “B alone is insufficient” and all of A, B, and C must be rerun.

S2.citation: The smell is absent: the artifact requires “one fresh, context-free agent per case” and a checkout sweep for context leakage.

S3.citation: The smell is absent: the artifact separately requires “Blind-run artifacts” and “Independent judgments.”

S4.citation: The smell of reporting only an aggregate score is absent: the artifact requires separate results for B and for A and C, though it fails O3 because it does not require repeated-trial pass rates.

S5.citation: The smell is absent: success requires “Results showing A and C still pass without regression.”

rationale: The artifact correctly requires a blind full-suite rerun, independent judging, regression checks, and legible before/after case evidence. It does not require enough repeated trials to calculate per-case pass rates, nor the diagnose-skill-defect-versus-bad-case, revise, and full-sweep loop for subsequent misses. Therefore not every criterion passes.
